title: First contact, the orchestrator's weight, and the 2.x migration
description: The packaging split was refused on a measurement, so the onboarding cost is repaired where it is paid: a one-command path to the smallest usable plan, a README that leads with what the baseline cannot do, a worked example that is not Node, orchestrator.md losing every rule a script now enforces, comments citing constraints rather than register ids, and a 2.x plan that opens under 3.0 with no manual step.
desiredOutcome: A bare repository reaches a manifest that makes the silent hooks speak in one command; the pitch is on the first screen; a second worked example exists and its gates are derived rather than copied; deleting any remaining section of the orchestrator reference turns a named check red; no comment cites a private register id; and a 2.x manifest fixture opens untouched with the one-repo boundary written down.
